defects.evidence: Replaced with CRLF-aware regex; collector rerun exit 0 with status OK; artifact_hashes.json regenerated.

audited_concerns.concern: complete_capture might publish while a coherent latch exists
audited_concerns.result: No public API path exists: complete_capture requires a ticket from begin_capture, and begin_capture revokes the latch and clears tickets before issuing one. The lifecycle test test_new_capture_revokes_latch_and_requires_release covers the specified behavior.

audited_concerns.concern: historical latch ratio_valid might remain observable after revocation
audited_concerns.result: Revocation drops the latch object, clears gain_ratio_valid and status bit 9, and retains bank bytes as historical/invalid. Tests test_second_latch_revokes_and_preserves_historical_bank and test_specified_revocation_causes_clear_coherence cover this.

unresolved_semantics: Active CONFIG and stopped/enabled state retention across set_context changes; the main spec only mandates revoking pending CONFIG, tickets and latch coherence.
Capture while stopped or fault-latched: current begin_capture gates only on active CONFIG and CDC, while ENABLE is fault-gated.
begin_capture proactively discards a generation-bound pending CONFIG request.
RELEASE invalidates an unlatched publication and pending CONFIG via generation advance.
A ticket is consumed by the first complete_capture attempt even if validation fails.
reset retains the fixture domain binding and conservatively retains capture batch/wire/tick high-water marks.
snapshot_latched bit 2 remains set after coherence revocation until RELEASE or reset.

Full ABI identity, CONFIG domain/context encoding, queue binding/unit/capacity, clock units/origin, period-width asymmetry, diagnostic bank, AXI response codes, calibration, time provenance and ACL/runtime proof remain A-owned.
After reset, the last active pair may be resumed with nondecreasing high-water marks; other used pairs remain barred. Whether reset should also bar the last pair is a fixture choice pending A.
